short: Stone Spirit Healing Arts offers intuitive tarot readings, spiritual guidance, and a unique, experiential approach to Reiki energy healing that incorporates art, creativity, and self-expression. As a Reiki Master and licensed mental health counselor with over 20 years of experience, I blend intuition, spiritual wisdom, and creative exploration to support self-discovery, emotional balance, personal growth, and a deeper connection with your authentic self.
training: Masters in Clinical Mental Health Counseling and Reiki Master, Masters in Fine Arts
